name: Distracting Charge
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Distracting Charge (Combat, Teamwork)
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 144
Your ally’s charge exposes an opening you can exploit.

Benefit: When your ally with this feat uses the charge action and hits, you gain a +2 bonus on your next attack roll against the target of that charge. This bonus must be used before your ally’s next turn, or it is lost.
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Pathfinder Unchained pg. 118
You can spend 1 stamina point when an ally with this feat charges but misses with the charge attack. When you do, you can still gain the benefit of this feat when you charge.
